Name: Morris' Spouse Portrait (Furniture Framework)
Author: laynsunder
Description:
[size=4][b]Did you marry Morris but are salty that you only get the "Manager of the Year" portrait? [/b][/size]

Look no further! I braved the terrifying world of coding because by the gods, I wanted a real Morris portrait and not that cartoony villain manager plaque. 

This should be simple enough for you

1. Download and unzip into your mod folder
2. Buy the furniture catalog if you haven't already
3. Profit(he should be at the very bottom of paintings)

Please, please let me know if anything gives you trouble. When I say terrifying world of coding... I mean for a good hour and some change I was revolving between outside furniture Morris, and rug Morris. I could not get this man to just stick to the wall like a good portrait. 

So without further ado, thank you to Poltergeister for the sprite for our favorite corporate man! And to my friend Chaotic for listening to my rant about outside Morris. 

Happy Farming!!
